name: valid-suite-retries-quarantine
description: A suite may declare a retry count from 0 to 3 and a quarantine list of globs.
yaml:
project: Demo
apps:
  - id: main
    platform: android
    appId: com.example.app
environments:
  staging:
    app: main
suites:
  regression:
    globs: ["tests/**"]
    retries: 2
    quarantine: ["tests/flaky/**"]
  smoke:
    tags: [smoke]
    retries: 0
